description: This file defines a singleton class 'SettingsWindowOpener' that manages opening a settings window within a macOS application. It includes a protocol for menu actions that can be invoked to show the settings or preferences windows, and contains logic to activate the app and trigger the appropriate window display actions.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for opening the settings window, either through a registered action or by mimicking the menu item actions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an OpenSettingsAction callback that will be invoked to open the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings or preferences window, either via the registered action or by simulating menu item actions.
